summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a standard open-market share buyback. On July 1, 2026, the company repurchased 5 million ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 111.36 pence through Goldman Sachs International. The purchases are part of an existing buyback program announced January 30, 2026, and shares will be cancelled. No premium, special tender, or structural complexity is involved. This is a routine capital return, not an Issuer Tender special situation.
